editorial_purpose: Turn the July 2026 annual gambling authorizations into a documented explainer about the local licensing regime, operators and physical footprint without equating an authorization with a newly opened venue.

verified_points: Local physical gambling requires an annual operating authorization granted by the Local Council in addition to the national ONJN regime.
The local annual authorization is valid for one year from issuance.
The local annual authorization tax is 1,000 lei per square metre per year of useful gambling area, including used common areas.
Failure to pay the local tax within 30 days of the council decision leads to withdrawal of the authorization.
The regulation restricts gambling locations around protected functions and in mapped prohibited perimeters.
Exterior windows must prevent visibility of gambling activity and exterior gambling advertising is prohibited; only neutral operator identification is allowed.
The adopted amendment removed the Piața Nord perimeter from the prohibited-area map.
